_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "initials" TEXT NOT NULL, "role_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone_assigned" TEXT NULL, "pin_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "password_hash" TEXT NULL, "firebase_uid" TEXT NULL, "disabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("disabled" IN (0, 1)), "avatar_color_hex" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#C08AFF', "capabilities_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "short" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#FF9233', "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'table_restaurant', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "venue_tables" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "pax" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "capacity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available', "open_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ready_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_actor_id" TEXT NULL, "locked_by" TEXT NULL, "locked_by_name" TEXT NULL, "locked_at" INTEGER NULL, "lock_expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "opened_at" INTEGER NULL, "guest_name" TEXT NULL, "guest_notes" TEXT NULL, "reservation_id" TEXT NULL, "current_visit_id" TEXT NULL, "bill_closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "money_state" TEXT NULL, "guest_ordering_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("guest_ordering_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "guest_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_label" TEXT NULL, "zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "pax" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opened_at" INTEGER NULL, "guest_name" TEXT NULL, "guest_notes" TEXT NULL, "reservation_id" TEXT NULL, "last_actor_id" TEXT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NULL, "member_attribution_version" INTEGER NULL, "table_freed_at" INTEGER NULL, "bill_closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "bill_closed_by" TEXT NULL, "loss_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dineIn', "channel" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "prepaid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("prepaid" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "guest_from_min" INTEGER NULL, "guest_to_min" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "base_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "prep_time" INTEGER NULL, "variants_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "modifier_groups_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "allergens_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "dietary_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "unavailable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("unavailable" IN (0, 1)), "photo" BLOB NULL, "photo_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "alcohol" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("alcohol" IN (0, 1)), "guest_visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("guest_visible" IN (0, 1)), "guest_featured" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("guest_featured" IN (0, 1)), "guest_stock_override" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "guest_override_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tickets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "course" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "modifiers_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "note" TEXT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "sent_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NULL, "replayed_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "fired_at" INTEGER NULL, "ready_at" INTEGER NULL, "served_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, "void_reason_code" TEXT NULL, "void_approved_by" TEXT NULL, "created_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "voided_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("token" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "issued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("token"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "public_key_pem" TEXT NOT NULL, "paired_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revoked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("revoked" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "idempotency" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "response_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "approved_by" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NULL, "actor_name" TEXT NULL, "actor_role_name" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NULL, "params" TEXT NULL, "payment_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "venue_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Warung Sebelah', "legal_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_header" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_footer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_tagline" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_social" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_thank_you" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_qr_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_qr_caption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "logo" BLOB NULL, "logo_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("tax_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "tax_rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1100, "service_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("service_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "service_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'percent', "service_rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 500, "service_fixed_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_after_discount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("tax_after_discount" IN (0, 1)), "business_day_start_hour" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "prep_target_mins" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15, "pickup_target_mins" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "ungreeted_mins" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, "ungreeted_escalate_mins" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "long_stay_mins" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90, "idle_table_mins" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "reservation_grace_mins" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15, "ungreeted_alert_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("ungreeted_alert_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "pickup_alert_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("pickup_alert_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sound_new_order" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'alert', "sound_ready" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'chime', "sound_void" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'alert', "sound_overdue" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'alert', "sound_ungreeted" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'chime', "sound_pickup" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'chime', "members_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("members_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "table_expense_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("table_expense_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "member_mirror_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("member_mirror_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "member_mirror_salt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "member_points_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("member_points_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "member_punch_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("member_punch_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "member_preset_id" TEXT NULL, "member_earn_per_thousand" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "member_point_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000, "member_redeem_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "member_punch_item_id" TEXT NULL, "member_punch_target" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "member_debt_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("member_debt_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "member_debt_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "member_debt_overdue_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "guest_ordering_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("guest_ordering_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "guest_note_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("guest_note_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "guest_hours_start_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "guest_hours_end_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "guest_max_items" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "guest_session_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "sound_guest_pending" TEXT NULL, "modules" TEXT NULL, "counter_config" TEXT NULL, "counter_guest_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "printers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "host" TEXT NOT NULL, "port" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 9100, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'escpos', "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "last_seen_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_label" TEXT NULL, "zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pax" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opened_at" INTEGER NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "void_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "service_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "net_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "settled_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ticket_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "loss_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "bill_closed_by" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dineIn', "channel" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "prepaid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("prepaid" IN (0, 1)), "expense_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "member_id" TEXT NULL, "member_attribution_version" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_session_tickets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ticket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "course" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "modifiers_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "note" TEXT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "sent_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fired_at" INTEGER NULL, "ready_at" INTEGER NULL, "served_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, "void_reason_code" TEXT NULL, "void_approved_by" TEXT NULL, "created_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "voided_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_session_courses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fired_at" INTEGER NULL, "served_at" INTEGER NULL, "ticket_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reservations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "party_size" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "expected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "zone_id" TEXT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "seated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'itemized', "label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "service_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unpaid', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ticket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_refund" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_refund" IN (0, 1)), "refunds_payment_id" TEXT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NULL, "tendered_amount" INTEGER NULL, "cashier_user_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "photo" BLOB NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_session_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'itemized', "label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "service_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unpaid', "member_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_session_receipt_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ticket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_session_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_refund" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_refund" IN (0, 1)), "cashier_user_id" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "photo" BLOB NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visit_expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visit_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "photo" BLOB NOT NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visit_expense_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "discount_presets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'order', "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'percent', "value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "discounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NULL, "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "ticket_id" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "preset_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "approved_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_session_discounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NULL, "ticket_id" TEXT NULL, "preset_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "approved_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_counters" ("date_str" TEXT NOT NULL, "takeaway_next" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("date_str"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ingredients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "stock_on_hand" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "low_stock_at" INTEGER NULL, "par_level" INTEGER NULL, "cost_micro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "batch_yield" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "option_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "ingredient_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ingredient_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "ticket_id" TEXT NULL, "source_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "user_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "cost_micro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "batch_id" TEXT NULL, "count_id" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_counts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "closed_by" TEXT NULL, "user_name" TEXT NULL, "closed_by_name" TEXT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'partial', "blind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("blind" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_count_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ingredient_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_qty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted_qty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_micro" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "reverses_id" TEXT NULL, "reversed_by_id" TEXT NULL, "counted_amount" INTEGER NULL, "photo" BLOB NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "actor_name" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NULL, "birthday" INTEGER NULL, "joined_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "debt_limit" INTEGER NULL, "kabupaten" TEXT NULL, "kecamatan" TEXT NULL, "kelurahan" TEXT NULL, "address_text" TEXT NULL, "mirror_rev" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "member_tombstones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "merged_into" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "member_points" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "base_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note" TEXT NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "actor_name" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "member_debts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_id" TEXT NULL, "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "bill_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "method" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "photo" BLOB NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "actor_name" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shifts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "ended_by" TEXT NULL, "last_activity_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "demo_states" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', "complete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("complete" IN (0, 1)), "days_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "days_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "prompt_answered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("prompt_answered" IN (0, 1)), "failed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("failed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guest_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guest_orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "submitted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "decided_at" INTEGER NULL, "decided_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "reject_reason_code" TEXT NULL, "visit_id" TEXT NULL, "ticket_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guest_order_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "course" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mains', "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "modifiers_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "note" TEXT NULL, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
